_comment: Allow-list of openbible editions this app offers, in preference order: "<iso>/<abbr>" (e.g. "ekk/OECV") or a project id. What exists, its books, license and CDN path come from bcv-commons/bibles' catalog/openbible-editions.json (see src/lib/bw/openbible-text.ts); enabling an edition is a licensing decision made here.
